description: Contract-2 greeting element line ('ธาตุของคุณคือ {ธาตุ} · {ดิถี}') is PROGRESSIVE: element (compute) can be present while the ดิถี band (persona) is not yet computed (before bazi #14). Must enhance gracefully and NEVER paint an orphan '·'. A whitespace-only band (' ') is truthy → a naive `strengthLabel ? …` leaks a bare '· ' (too's bare-bullet catch on the persona anchor). Fix = trim-guard at the component (`strengthLabel?.trim() ? …`) + drop the '·' when band absent + hide the whole row when no data (element & mascot share one compute → null together, no orphan mascot). Teeth-proven (run-element-line.ts, neg-control-first, reads rendered glyphs): full 'ไม้ · ดิถีอ่อน' (bullet+band); partial/blankband 'ไม้' (bullet dropped); none → row hidden; mut-bare-bullet (inject the '· ' a naive check emits) → orphan-'·' gate CAUGHT. gate_layer=visual/rendered-text. Cross-lens: goo=strengthLabel never whitespace at source (data) · me=trim-guard + null-hide + orphan gate (visual). Copy=ground-truth ดิถี band (ฟีม 2026-07-25), not Figma 'แข็งแรง'.
